program.name: Floor Strength & Stretch
program.subject: Strength & stretch
program.blurb: No gear and not much time: bodyweight supersets, then a stretch.
program.about: Strength and stretching on the floor in under half an hour. Push-ups pair with floor pulls one day and squats with bridges the next, and a short flow opens what you trained. Nothing to set up. Level II adds reps and Level III slows every rep down.
program.split: Push-pull supersets & opener / leg supersets & hip flow, short
